neighbours.label: the tokens ' tend' / ' tends' / ' tendency' (strongest in 'tend to' + verb)
fire: Teenagers in my class tend to sleep late on weekends.
Older dogs often tend to gain weight in winter.
In my experience, cheap shoes tend to fall apart quickly.
This kind of soil tends to hold water after a storm.
Honestly, I tend to overthink every small decision.
Voters in rural areas tended to favor the incumbent.
Our cat has a tendency to hide under the bed.
Investors tend to panic when markets fall.
